origin.rule: Reproduce unlocked Stage1g for each seed. Before readout, byte-compare cores, ordered formed edges/weights, entire native locked export, formation responses and jitter draws with the original evidence; freeze refs.

apparatus.outputs: Two centre cells O_A/O_B, recordOutput=true, no outgoing edges, growthAt1e12. No output clamp; natural activity retained.
apparatus.projections: Every pool cell to each O, ordinary native Synapse at0.02, native geometric delay; no identity-based wiring. Preserve pool radius60. Constructor wiring is the declared dense apparatus, not endogenous growth.

phaseBoundary.reason: Permanent settings, saved in effective config and native snapshots; decay alreadyoff. Existing pool weights checked with exact equality, never tolerance.

apparatus.threshold: Fixed factor0.25 * frozen reference core size * maxWeight1.65; no retuning.
apparatus.plasticity: Only postsynaptic O cells receive env.features.hebbian=true; all original cells false. Same native per-cell environment override pattern as fact-memory. Host scope metadata stored and reinstated on native development restore.

training.phaseSeed: (seed ^ 0x94d049bb) >>> 0; independent U{0..15} draw per cue bit, shared across matched controls.
training.teacher: Native env.forcedSpike on the selected O at t0+teacherTick. No output clamp or refractory bypass. Save each delivered request/veto and first epoch of a natural spike before the matching teacher.
training.stopping: First checkpoint20..80, every10, where R1/R2/R3 all pass at both delays. R4 not consulted by stopping. Continue primary to80 for curves; controls trained to the selected epoch.

probes.cues: Full A/B/C and both fixed even/odd4-bit halves of A/B. Synchronous independent locked clones, no teacher.
probes.margins: Input margin = sum of all weights arriving during capture minus fixed O threshold, including refractory-discarded arrivals. Also report integrated charge, native first-spike potential/threshold, and peak leaky membrane margin over nonrefractory ticks. Raw charge margin alone is not a firing test.

gates.R1: Full A->O_A only, full B->O_B only, both delays.
gates.R2: Each A/B half->its own O only, both delays.
gates.R3: Full C fires neither O, both delays.
gates.R4: Pool->pool ordered IDs/weights exactly equal original1g; original formation gates2/4/8/9 on frozen refs, including >=0.25 gain versus initial untrained formation. Failures in unablated scientific runs are harness errors to investigate before interpretation.
gates.R5: Host codebook vocabulary.get(conceptId).word; output identities follow teacher labels, not input text copying.

controls.readout-hebbian-off: Match stop duration, O plasticityfalse. R1 must fail; no O output on any probe.
controls.prune-readout: Restore exact stop; natively prune pool->O weights>0.1; R1 fails and every full/half/C pool response stays exactly unchanged.
controls.swapped-teacher: Match stop duration with O_B teaching on A and O_A on B. Full A->O_B only and B->O_A only at both delays.
controls.prune-formed: Restore exact stop; prune all grown pool->pool edges only. R2 fails while R1 passes.
controls.untrained-readout: Apparatus installed at1g stop, zero readout epochs; no O output on any probe.

weights: Report both O input distributions from refA/refB/other, explicitly noting overlapping reference members appear in both core groups; selectivity(mean own-mean other)/maxWeight.
decision: GO iff the reused seed1 and new seeds2/3 at tick24/factor0.25 reach criterion and pass R1-R4 and all five required control discriminations. Otherwise name failing gates/discriminations. Exit0GO,1scientificNO-GO,2executionerror.

reference.rule: Reuse every saved seed-1 case file and its reproduced origin byte-for-byte. Re-evaluate its acceptance; do not retrain seed1.

selection: The passing diagnostic nearest the original primary: tick24/factor0.25. Only seeds2/3 are run, each with all five matched controls. No other factor or tick.

additionalMeasurements.negative: For each O at both delays: C peak membrane margin, peak potential/effective threshold, fixed threshold and headroom=-peakMargin.
additionalMeasurements.natural: First non-driven, non-external output spike in the recorded65-tick presentation windows, across both A/B trials; separately report first natural-before-matching-teacher epoch. Report at stop and through80. Gap spikes are outside this retained observation window.
